name: DigitalOcean
subtitle: Developer-friendly cloud (Droplets and App Platform)
creator: Ben and Moisey Uretsky
description: A cloud known for simple pricing and clear tutorials. Droplets are virtual servers you control; App Platform deploys from Git like a PaaS; managed databases and Kubernetes are available too.

languages.youWrite: Anything on a Droplet; App Platform detects most languages

concepts.explanation: Virtual servers billed by the hour.

codeSamples.label: YAML · App Platform spec
codeSamples.code:
name: my-app
services:
  - name: web
    github:
      repo: acme/my-app
      branch: main
    build_command: npm run build
    run_command: npm start
    http_port: 3000
databases:
  - name: db
    engine: PG

pricing.summary: Basic Droplets (virtual servers) from $4/mo. App Platform includes free static sites. New accounts often get $200 credit for 60 days.
